answer: A ferrous census bond blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent registers a walnut plot with a key-bound ferrous marker and locks a 75-credit bond. A pulse audit samples plots each epoch and re-measures walnut counts; duplicates burn the bond. Filing costs 42 first, 42+7(k-1) for the k-th; 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented surveys fail the pulse re-measurement: markers are key-bound. Honest agents pay 42 once, keep the bond.
